terms.comment: A country takes a preposition: in Ucraīnam (to), in Ucraīnā (in), ex Ucraīnā (from).

ucraina.html: The long vowel puts the Latin stress where Ukrainian Україна has it, by the convention for modern names.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).
